definition: the process of taking in and letting out air
description: A woman in a bright patchwork ski jacket and striped hat stands on packed snow high in the mountains, the Matterhorn sharp against a deep blue sky behind her. She looks straight into the camera, purses her lips and breathes out hard, and a thick white cloud of warm air bursts from her mouth and drifts away in the cold. She does it again, laughing, and other walkers standing further back on the snow do the same, so several white puffs hang in the air at once.

taps.target: the person in the white hat
